successor_revision_requirements: Correct EV-ZLIB-TEST-005 rationale: example.c does not demonstrate reset workflows.
Resolve or explicitly scope repeated inflate behavior after Z_STREAM_END using sufficient approved evidence.
Include D1-D8 defect-category definitions in reviewer-visible specification material.
Define whether DEFLATE_READY/DEFLATE_ACTIVE represent documented call history or exact implementation status; do not describe post-error dictionary use as documented-valid.
Define lifecycle semantics for INIT_FAILED and RELEASED, including whether reinitialization starts a fresh lifecycle.
Remove T15 from source-oriented ZLIB-R02 or model source validity with a separate ownership-neutral source-side relation.
Define open-world versus closed-world transition-table semantics and the meaning of an absent transition.

Explicitly handle or exclude additional relevant stateful zlib APIs such as deflateCopy, deflateParams, deflateResetKeep, deflateSetHeader, inflateSetDictionary, inflateReset2, inflatePrime, inflateSync, and inflateGetHeader.
Explicitly include or exclude gzip-wrapper stream mode and state whether claims depend on a pinned build configuration.
Promote ZLIB-CAND-R14 as an accepted ownership rule, with appropriate evidence and explicitly defined resource scope.
